ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 85% of the visible surface area, creating a sharp contrast against low-intensity black pixels localized at the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blobs dominate the interior of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous irregular border along the trailing edge and tips, with a vertical fragmented cluster (mottling) localized at the central median notch extending downward toward the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are visible across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks and deep valleys are concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the center to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters (scars or pigmentation spots) scattered across the medial regions of both white lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct horizontal and diagonal thin dark linear streaks (rake marks) are detected across the right lobe; a single elongated diagonal line is visible on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel rake marks (linear abrasions) are visible on the right lobe surface. Irregular, fragmented pigmentation 'splatters' are localized around the central notch area.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, thin, isolated black linear streak extends from the central black cluster diagonally toward the lower-left section of the fluke.
